cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you put your coat on, let me conclude our coffee properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said ten minutes. My bus is due.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ten minutes describes duration, not closure. Sit down, please; I'll decide whether we've reached a suitable stopping point.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cafe is closing. They've asked both of us to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then wait beside the door. Put your coat on, certainly, but please don't mistake that for being dismissed.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 professionally corrects duration into closure criteria; A5 grants a coat but reserves dismissal despite staff ending the visit.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 bus due and B4 venue closing are compatible pressures; A5 proposes waiting rather than pretending the meeting already moved.

relationship.evidence: B2 insists on agreed time; B4 uses staff instructions to end the encounter, both credible concerns.

heightening.evidence: B4 closure causes A5 door relocation and narrowly permitted coat, retaining control of actual departure.

specificity.evidence: A1 coffee and coat plus B2 bus make the social situation legible without invented roles.

brevityWit.evidence: A1 no longer explains a distinction twice; A5 coat permission and warning function as one attempt to keep B present.
